title: Data Egress Trace Classifier
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Decide where the data in each of eight flows ends up: on the DGX, on the evaluator's own machine, or with a third party.

educational.topic: Containing the Harness: Containers and Network Boundaries
learningObjectives: The learner will distinguish, for 8 data flows in a local-generation setup, whether each stays on the DGX, goes to the evaluator's own machine, or goes to a third party, with at least 7 of 8 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: Flow 5 starts on the evaluator's own laptop and still counts as going to a third party. Explain why.
commonMisconceptions: A locally hosted model means no data leaves.
Traffic to the evaluator's own laptop is traffic to a third party.
A one-time download is not egress.
The supervising assistant's reads are local.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt.

chapter_title: Containing the Harness: Containers and Network Boundaries
